title: Replay Pruning and Few-Bit Integer Inference for Hardware-Efficient Speed-Sign Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.22811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speed-limit sign recognition on an automotive camera system-on-chip (SoC) must fit a detector and a classifier (the reader) into the memory, arithmetic, and energy budgets of the device. In our two-stage recognizer, the detector, a YOLO-family network with ReLU and hard-sigmoid operators, is compressed by channel replay: an iterative pruning cascade identifies the channels to remove, the recorded deletions are replayed on the original task-trained network, the parent, and one continuous knowledge-distillation recovery follows. On a YOLOv5n, replay removes 60.3% of the parameters at the accuracy of the parent and, in validation mAP50-95 over five matched seeds, outperforms iterative pruning and training from scratch, and its per-step variant (per-step replay) is the most accurate pruning method. On a YOLOv8n, replay and per-step replay outperform every other method and the unpruned parent. The reader, a five-layer CNN with 18k parameter

translated_title: 面向硬件高效限速标志识别的重放剪枝与少比特整数推理
translated_abstract: 在汽车摄像头片上系统上，限速标志识别必须将检测器和分类器（读取器）塞进设备的内存、算术和能耗预算之中。在我们的两阶段识别器中，检测器是一个采用ReLU和hard-sigmoid算子的YOLO系列网络，通过通道重放进行压缩：迭代剪枝级联识别出需要移除的通道，记录的删除操作在原始任务训练的父网络上重放，随后进行一次连续的知识蒸馏恢复。在YOLOv5n上，重放在保持父网络精度的同时移除了60.3%的参数，并且在五个匹配种子的验证mAP50-95上优于迭代剪枝和从头训练，其每步变体是精度最高的剪枝方法。在YOLOv8n上，重放和每步重放优于所有其他方法以及未剪枝的父网络。读取器是一个拥有18k参数的五层CNN
tldr: 提出通道重放剪枝方法，通过在原始训练网络上重放记录的剪枝删除并结合知识蒸馏恢复，在保持父网络精度的同时移除YOLO网络60%以上的参数，实现汽车SoC上硬件高效的限速标志识别。
en_tdlr: Proposes channel replay pruning, which replays recorded pruning deletions on the original task-trained network followed by knowledge-distillation recovery, removing over 60% of YOLO parameters at parent-level accuracy for hardware-efficient speed-sign recognition on automotive SoCs.
